{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-stot","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: Ack from_bytes_for decodes window from wrong bit position","description":"## Bug
`Ack::write_to` encodes the window in bit 7 of byte 1:
```rust
out[1] = (self.window & 1) << 7;  // line 283
```
But `Ack::from_bytes_for` decodes the window from `FRAGMENT_N` (bit 6) of byte 1:
```rust
let window = (data[1] >> FRAGMENT_N) & 1;  // line 305, FRAGMENT_N = 6
```

This encode/decode mismatch causes all non-complete ACK parsing to fail with `NonCanonicalAck` errors, because the round-trip check at line 342-346 will produce different output than the input.

## Impact
`FragmentSender::handle_ack_bytes` cannot process any incoming ACKs, making the fragmentation sender non-functional for retransmission handling.

## Fix
Change `from_bytes_for` line 305 to use bit 7: `let window = data[1] >> 7;` to match `write_to` line 283.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T17:30:21.268735282Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T17:30:21.268735282Z"}
